updates.scope_and_remaining_work: Block 06 closes the exact six-way criterion for a nonzero finite-dimensional operator over an arbitrary field. The final List.TFAE includes actual cyclicity, canonical seed rank one, cyclicity of every nonzero intrinsic primary component, an actual monic positive-degree one-invariant-factor presentation, minpoly=charpoly, and one-dimensional eigenspaces at every spectral value of the literal tensor extension to AlgebraicClosure k. Minimal-polynomial preservation and cyclicity preservation/descent are proved, not supplied as hypotheses. The one-factor presentation has a constructed basis in which the original operator is the standard companion matrix; its factor is proved to be the minimal polynomial. A separate theorem proves that any actual nonconstant invariant-factor chain has exactly one factor iff the operator is cyclic. This is a mathematical existence and equivalence theorem, not an executable normal-form algorithm or a full sorted invariant-factor construction for arbitrary noncyclic operators. The nonzero-space guard is retained in the six-way statement. Legacy conditional wrappers are preserved unchanged for compatibility, but the new public criterion needs no decomposition, multiplicity, polynomial-preservation, spectral, or seed-number certificates.
